_readme: Native charts replace the dashed placeholders only when verified is true. The chart-builder agent fills this file from fact-checked data. The fact-checker agent must confirm every value and its source before verified is set to true.

A.title: AI Infrastructure Debt Yields (%)
A.footnote: Bars mix pricing dates (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026), maturities and instruments. A spread over Treasuries version is preferred; only Hyperion (about 225bps) and El Paso (about 287.5bps, press: PitchBook) spreads are found, so raw yields are shown pending verification.

B.title: Hyperscaler Bond Issuance ($bn)
B.footnote: 2025 and 2026 to Jul 7 cover four issuers (Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle). 2026E and 2027E are Goldman Sachs estimates for five hyperscalers, adding Microsoft.

C.title: 2026 Capex Versus Debt Funding ($bn)
C.footnote: Goldman Sachs estimates for five hyperscalers (Meta, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Oracle). Debt issuance is about one third of capex.

D.title: Lease Term Versus Debt Maturity (years)
labels: El Paso potential term (with four extensions)
D.footnote: Initial lease terms are committed; the El Paso potential term assumes all four extension options are exercised. Bond maturities are approximate years from pricing (Hyperion 2049 maturity month not found, so 23 or 24 years).
sources: Meta press release, July 2026 (El Paso lease terms)
